messages:
Priya Rao: Heads up team 30 candidate Emma Svensson is traveling in from out of state for an interview day on 2026-05-12. She requested an overnight hotel + shuttle, a shipping kit for a small hardware task, and a gluten-free lunch. Can we confirm logistics? :calendar:

Diego Morales: I can own hotel booking. Any preferred hotel block? We usually use Red Maple across the street. Need arrival/departure times.

Priya Rao: Red Maple is great. Arrival evening 5/11, departure morning 5/13. Please include early check-in if possible (flight lands 3pm). Also request a quiet room.

HR Coordinator: Noted. Will ask for a low-floor, no-fridge room (candidate requested low scent). Also confirm reimbursement policy for ride from airport?

Priya Rao: We reimburse ride to/from airport up to $80 each way. Add note in invite and expense guide.

Facilities: Shuttle is available 9-5 weekdays only. For off-hours we provide ride-share voucher. Which does Emma need?

Priya Rao: Emmas flight lands at 3pm on 5/11 so shuttle should be fine. Please schedule pickup at 3:45pm at Terminal A curbside.

Priya Rao: Also she needs a hardware kit shipped to her hotel for a short hands-on task (tiny dev board + USB-C power + instructions). Can we ship overnight and include a return label?

Diego Morales: Shipping ok. Who covers shipping cost? Ops budget? Also need the hotel address to print label.

HR Coordinator: People Ops covers shipping. Priya, can you confirm the exact device SKU and a contact at Vendor?

Priya Rao: SKU: RWI-KIT-02 (includes devboard, USB-C cable, microSD). Ship via FedEx overnight. Return label: prepaid FedEx Ground (2-day). Please include a sticky note: "Interview kit - please keep until 5/13".

Facilities: Hotel address: Red Maple Hotel, 120 Redwood Ave, Floor/Desk: Front Desk. I'll DM the front desk contact to expect the package.

Vendor Catering: Ordering lunch 30 we can do gluten-free boxed lunches (salad + grilled chicken substitute). Any nut allergies?

Priya Rao: Candidate is gluten-free and allergic to shellfish. No nuts reported. Please mark as GF and nut-free. Also include bottled water and plain coffee.

PeopleOps Bot: Hotel block reserved: HB-20260512-77 (3 nights reserved, early check-in request submitted). Shuttle pickup scheduled: 2026-05-11 15:45 Terminal A. Shipping request logged: SHIP-4892. Return label created: RRET-4892.

Diego Morales: I'll place the FedEx overnight label tomorrow. ETA to hotel should be 5/11 evening. I'll also add a note to the calendar invite about kit handling and return label steps.

HR Coordinator: I'll update the interview invite with travel reimbursement instructions and attach the expense form. Also adding a point of contact: Priya (415-555-0133).

Priya Rao: Thanks all. Final checks: someone to greet at reception? I can do 9:30am check-in on 5/12, but if I'm tied up can @Diego fill in.

Diego Morales: I can cover if needed. Ping me if early check-in gets confirmed and you need backup.

Facilities: Confirmed with front desk to hold kit and leave at concierge under "Emma Svensson". We'll post a sign at 2pm on 5/11 indicating pickup.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: send travel + hotel + shuttle + kit tracking email to candidate 48 hours before arrival. :::end of thread:::
